    • resolveFullUrl

      public static String resolveFullUrl(String mediaUrl)

    • loadAvatar

      public static void loadAvatar(javafx.scene.shape.Circle circle, String pfpUrl, arkheim.client.presentation.theme.ThemeMode themeMode)
      Loads an avatar image into a JavaFX Circle using ImagePattern. If pfpUrl is null or blank, falls back to default_pfp.png. Clicking the avatar opens it in full resolution modal with download capability (like post media).

    • createMediaPreviewNode

      public static javafx.scene.Node createMediaPreviewNode(String mediaUrl, arkheim.client.presentation.theme.ThemeMode themeMode)
      Creates a shrunken preview component for a post card. Scales down media until it reaches a fixed height bound (max 260px), preserving aspect ratio. Clicking the preview opens the media in full resolution modal with a download button.

    • showFullResolutionDialog

      public static void showFullResolutionDialog(String fullUrl, arkheim.client.presentation.theme.ThemeMode themeMode)
      Opens a full-resolution modal stage containing the media and a Download button.

    • getOSDownloadsFolder

      public static File getOSDownloadsFolder()
      Resolves user's OS downloads directory (~/Downloads).
